svg.title: Woodcut — music video style reference (c4-woodcut)
svg.desc: A two-block relief print. Every measured word takes another cut out of the block, so each line is finished as it is sung. Frame is 1600x900; the strip below the frame is apparatus, not part of the film.

g.text: SO I'M RUNNING INTO THE WILD
SO I'M RUNNING INTO THE WILD

svg.text: SECTION VARIATION — THE SAME STYLE AT FIVE POINTS IN THE SONG
The title cut out of the lower block a letter
at a time, over a sun cut behind the range.
"Ebony, ivory, and bone": the ground in
section, each thing cut on its own word.
First chorus is a paper dawn. The second runs
at night; the third floods the sky red.
No lyric. A great sun on the sea, one ray cut
per bar; the lower block keeps count.
each cut on the word that names it.
